excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a paleontologist, short brown hair, Latino ethnicity. Signature thin-rimmed BLACK aviator lens glasses.
excavation_context.uniform: A light white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, khaki shorts and brown hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_4 is inside a field laboratory tent, using a humming air scribe tool on a flat plate of pale ash-grey volcanic tuff matrix. Brittle ash flakes fly back as he carefully exposes the delicate, bird-like claw elements of a Xiaotingia specimen under brilliant overhead utility lighting. Glare shines realistically across his black aviator glasses. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
